frame_timestamp_role: recording duration and source-clock diagnostics only
known_failures_fixed: A parseable truncated frame timestamp could expand one video interval across decades when min/max was used.
Some recorder frame clocks differ from Session Timestamp by hours or weeks; using them as absolute clinical time can match the wrong hospitalization or lab result.

validation.session_local_patient_id: must match the patient directory ID
validation.session_embedded_hospital_id: must match the merged patient mapping
validation.session_plausible_range: 2018-01-01 through one year after parser execution
validation.frame_timestamp_cleanup: reject malformed, non-finite, implausible, non-increasing, and discontinuous rows; use the longest contiguous segment
validation.lab_matching_scope: the complete session interval and matched lab must be in exactly one hospitalization

source_clock_warning_behavior: retain the sample when Session Timestamp and IDs/hospitalization validate; never substitute the frame clock
